{"items":[{"ref":"E01","coverage_id":"coverage-2fabf7bc641eedee","coverage_title":"选择页：更换为下午二层服务台并进入核对页","task_id":"TASK1","applicability":"applicable","reason":"任务明确要求更换选择并进入核对页；现有选择页提供入口，路径行为仍待观察。","source_ids":["src-d643f19b03384ce2a036f12ba71161a2","src-5f735d74eaf1428987f7af4dc1257cbd"],"evidence_ids":["ev-3288eb39e0534307aab6e3698122ae62","ev-91397b03af5640368d2dfc61172bae20"],"evidence_needed":["更换选择及点击“核对信息”的动作记录","核对页画面与目标身份"],"object_refs":["选择页两个时段选项","核对信息按钮"],"object_ids":["obj-f729e47050118a39e54b","obj-19e79bdc189741edbd92"],"constraint_refs":["REQ1"],"required_evidence_kinds":["requirement","design","observation"]},{"ref":"E01","coverage_id":"coverage-a46b9cb50cb7b416","coverage_title":"BR1：核对页通过“返回选择”回到选择页","task_id":"TASK2","applicability":"applicable","reason":"BR1明确规定返回路径；需取得核对页入口及返回结果，不能以任务卡证明路径可通。","source_ids":["src-5f735d74eaf1428987f7af4dc1257cbd","src-d643f19b03384ce2a036f12ba71161a2"],"evidence_ids":["ev-91397b03af5640368d2dfc61172bae20"],"evidence_needed":["核对页及“返回选择”入口","返回动作与前后画面"],"object_refs":["BR1","核对页返回选择入口"],"object_ids":[],"constraint_refs":["REQ2"],"required_evidence_kinds":["requirement","design","observation"]},{"ref":"E01","coverage_id":"coverage-b39afc42ea3b3008","coverage_title":"BR2：提交登记到达完成页","task_id":"TASK3","applicability":"applicable","reason":"任务声明提交后的完成页终点；需检查实际提交入口、动作及抵达对象。","source_ids":["src-5f735d74eaf1428987f7af4dc1257cbd","src-d643f19b03384ce2a036f12ba71161a2"],"evidence_ids":["ev-91397b03af5640368d2dfc61172bae20"],"evidence_needed":["最终核对页及提交入口","提交动作与完成页画面"],"object_refs":["BR2","提交入口与完成页"],"object_ids":[],"constraint_refs":["REQ3"],"required_evidence_kinds":["requirement","design","observation"]},{"ref":"E01","coverage_id":"coverage-7686ff9c10b2feb6","coverage_title":"BR3：完成后重新开始复位","task_id":"TASK3","applicability":"applicable","reason":"材料明确说明“重新开始”可复位；作为补充路径检查，不新增三条设计要求以外的验收要求。","source_ids":["src-5f735d74eaf1428987f7af4dc1257cbd","src-d643f19b03384ce2a036f12ba71161a2"],"evidence_ids":["ev-91397b03af5640368d2dfc61172bae20"],"evidence_needed":["完成页“重新开始”入口","复位动作及返回选择页的画面"],"object_refs":["BR3"],"object_ids":[],"constraint_refs":[],"required_evidence_kinds":["statement","design","observation"]},{"ref":"E02","coverage_id":"coverage-a46b9cb50cb7b416","coverage_title":"BR1：核对页返回后的时段及服务台一致性","task_id":"TASK2","applicability":"applicable","reason":"REQ2明确同一次选择在返回前后应保持一致；比较位置有要求依据，实际字段画面尚缺。","source_ids":["src-5f735d74eaf1428987f7af4dc1257cbd","src-d643f19b03384ce2a036f12ba71161a2"],"evidence_ids":["ev-91397b03af5640368d2dfc61172bae20"],"evidence_needed":["下午选中状态及对应核对页","返回动作后选中时段与服务台","同轮同版本的动作关联记录"],"object_refs":["BR1","同一次登记的时段及服务台"],"object_ids":[],"constraint_refs":["REQ2"],"required_evidence_kinds":["requirement","design","observation"]},{"ref":"E02","coverage_id":"coverage-b39afc42ea3b3008","coverage_title":"BR2：最终确认信息与完成页结果一致性","task_id":"TASK3","applicability":"applicable","reason":"REQ3明确最终确认与完成结果属于同次登记，应比较时段和服务台，不能用初始默认值代替最终值。","source_ids":["src-5f735d74eaf1428987f7af4dc1257cbd","src-d643f19b03384ce2a036f12ba71161a2"],"evidence_ids":["ev-91397b03af5640368d2dfc61172bae20"],"evidence_needed":["提交前最终确认的时段及服务台","完成页对应字段","关联提交前后的同轮动作记录"],"object_refs":["BR2","最终确认信息与登记结果"],"object_ids":[],"constraint_refs":["REQ3"],"required_evidence_kinds":["requirement","design","observation"]},{"ref":"E03","coverage_id":"coverage-2fabf7bc641eedee","coverage_title":"选择页：切换下午选项后的选中反馈","task_id":"TASK1","applicability":"applicable","reason":"存在可切换单选项，当前上午已选、下午未选；需核对切换动作与选中反馈的对应关系。","source_ids":["src-d643f19b03384ce2a036f12ba71161a2","src-5f735d74eaf1428987f7af4dc1257cbd"],"evidence_ids":["ev-3288eb39e0534307aab6e3698122ae62","ev-91397b03af5640368d2dfc61172bae20"],"evidence_needed":["下午选项触发记录","动作后两个单选项的状态及画面"],"object_refs":["周五09:00–09:30／一层服务台","周五14:00–14:30／二层服务台"],"object_ids":["obj-f729e47050118a39e54b"],"constraint_refs":["REQ1"],"required_evidence_kinds":["requirement","design","observation"]},{"ref":"E03","coverage_id":"coverage-b39afc42ea3b3008","coverage_title":"BR2：提交动作与完成反馈对应","task_id":"TASK3","applicability":"applicable","reason":"提交应产生当前登记的完成反馈；仅有选择页，尚不能确认提交触发及反馈状态。","source_ids":["src-5f735d74eaf1428987f7af4dc1257cbd","src-d643f19b03384ce2a036f12ba71161a2"],"evidence_ids":["ev-91397b03af5640368d2dfc61172bae20"],"evidence_needed":["提交前状态及实际触发记录","提交后反馈画面与观察条件"],"object_refs":["BR2","登记完成反馈"],"object_ids":[],"constraint_refs":["REQ3"],"required_evidence_kinds":["requirement","design","observation"]},{"ref":"R20","coverage_id":"coverage-2fabf7bc641eedee","coverage_title":"选择页：品牌及辅助信息与选择任务的层级","task_id":"TASK1","applicability":"applicable","reason":"任务内容明确，完整截图包含品牌、页脚及选择区，可检查辅助内容是否遮挡或挤占主要任务。","source_ids":["src-d643f19b03384ce2a036f12ba71161a2","src-5f735d74eaf1428987f7af4dc1257cbd"],"evidence_ids":["ev-3288eb39e0534307aab6e3698122ae62","ev-91397b03af5640368d2dfc61172bae20"],"evidence_needed":[],"object_refs":["选择页品牌区、页脚、时段选项及核对入口"],"object_ids":["obj-f729e47050118a39e54b"],"constraint_refs":["REQ1"],"required_evidence_kinds":["requirement","design"]},{"ref":"R21","coverage_id":"coverage-b39afc42ea3b3008","coverage_title":"BR2：若提交出现错误，检查问题定位","task_id":"TASK3","applicability":"needs_context","reason":"提交后是否存在错误状态尚未知；初始选择页不能证明后续没有错误提示。","source_ids":["src-d643f19b03384ce2a036f12ba71161a2","src-5f735d74eaf1428987f7af4dc1257cbd"],"evidence_ids":["ev-3288eb39e0534307aab6e3698122ae62","ev-91397b03af5640368d2dfc61172bae20"],"evidence_needed":["提交后的状态画面","若出现错误，取得完整原文及关联操作范围"],"object_refs":["BR2","可能出现的提交错误提示"],"object_ids":[],"constraint_refs":[],"required_evidence_kinds":["design","observation"]},{"ref":"R22","coverage_id":"coverage-b39afc42ea3b3008","coverage_title":"BR2：若提交出现错误，检查修正说明","task_id":"TASK3","applicability":"needs_context","reason":"尚未确认提交错误及可由用户执行的处理途径，不能判定修正说明是否适用或缺失。","source_ids":["src-d643f19b03384ce2a036f12ba71161a2","src-5f735d74eaf1428987f7af4dc1257cbd"],"evidence_ids":["ev-3288eb39e0534307aab6e3698122ae62","ev-91397b03af5640368d2dfc61172bae20"],"evidence_needed":["错误状态及完整提示","用户可修正性的依据","明确关联的帮助或恢复说明"],"object_refs":["BR2","可能出现的错误修正说明"],"object_ids":[],"constraint_refs":[],"required_evidence_kinds":["design","observation","statement"]},{"ref":"R23","coverage_id":"coverage-b39afc42ea3b3008","coverage_title":"BR2：若提交出现错误，检查提示语言","task_id":"TASK3","applicability":"needs_context","reason":"错误提示对象与目标用户背景均未提供，不能推断提示存在或用户是否理解。","source_ids":["src-d643f19b03384ce2a036f12ba71161a2","src-5f735d74eaf1428987f7af4dc1257cbd"],"evidence_ids":["ev-3288eb39e0534307aab6e3698122ae62","ev-91397b03af5640368d2dfc61172bae20"],"evidence_needed":["若出现错误，取得完整提示原文","影响理解判断的目标用户背景"],"object_refs":["BR2","可能出现的面向用户错误文案"],"object_ids":[],"constraint_refs":[],"required_evidence_kinds":["design","observation","statement"]},{"ref":"R24","coverage_id":"coverage-2fabf7bc641eedee","coverage_title":"选择页：时段及服务台是否需要就近解释","task_id":"TASK1","applicability":"needs_context","reason":"时段与服务台对象已知，但用户知识及解释需要未明确，不能仅凭页面简单判定不适用。","source_ids":["src-d643f19b03384ce2a036f12ba71161a2","src-5f735d74eaf1428987f7af4dc1257cbd"],"evidence_ids":["ev-3288eb39e0534307aab6e3698122ae62","ev-91397b03af5640368d2dfc61172bae20"],"evidence_needed":["目标用户知识与解释需要的依据","若确认需要解释，取得相关说明或帮助内容"],"object_refs":["选择时段及服务台步骤"],"object_ids":["obj-f729e47050118a39e54b"],"constraint_refs":[],"required_evidence_kinds":["statement","design"]}]}
